name: response-branches
purpose: Pages through alternative versions of one assistant response: after Regenerate, or when the model returned several candidates, the message shows one version at a time with a `‹ 2 of 3 ›` pager under it. The owner keeps every version and renders the active one in the default slot; the component owns only the position and the pager. It is the AI Elements `Branch` pattern, rebuilt on WebKit's `IconButton` and tokens.
useWhen: A response was regenerated and the earlier versions stay available to compare.
A model returned several candidates and the person picks the one to keep reading.
avoidWhen: Pages of one long list → use `Pagination`.
Different documents side by side → use `Tabs`.
related: chat-message` — the message whose body the branches wrap; its actions hold Regenerate.
streaming-response` — a new version streams in the slot while the pager already counts it.
bestPractices: Move to the new version when Regenerate finishes (set `v-model` to the last index) so the person sees what they asked for.
Keep the versions in the order they were made; the newest is last.
Do not render the pager inside the slot; it belongs to the component so its position and labels stay the same across versions.

props.name: count
props.doc: How many versions exist. With one or none the pager is not drawn.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the pager group. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Response versions`).

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Locks the pager, for example while a new version streams.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: The active version. Rendered once; the owner switches its content by `index`.
